newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast wholesale gasoline flat amid thin talk.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast wholesale gasoline flat amid thin talk.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined petroleum products were steady Wednesday, with a golf tournament leaving the market with a lower-than-normal number of players, market observers said.

A lack of direction from the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) also discouraged local spot trade. While September crude oil futures fell 10 cents a barrel, front-month unleaded gasoline jumped 1.10 cents a gallon after U.S. government oil data showed a drop in supply.
"There's nothing much going on today (locally)," a broker said.
Traders offered August CARB gasoline in Los Angeles between 58.50 cents and 59.50 cents a gallon, equal to Tuesday's levels, with a few remaining volumes of July gasoline talked 60/60.50 cents.
CARB diesel was notionally flat in Los Angeles, with 55.50 and 56.50 cents a gallon the latest numbers discussed.
State-mandated CARB gasoline was talked 59.50/60.50 cents a gallon, notionally steady.
